Scott Wilson Group | Scott Wilson Group plc was a global integrated design and engineering consultancy with its headquarters in the United Kingdom. Scott Wilson offered consultancy and professional services in the railways, buildings and infrastructure, environment and natural resources and roads sectors, and at its peak employed 5,500 people in 80 offices worldwide.  Scott Wilson became a public limited company in 2006, and in 2010 was purchased by the American firm URS Corporation.  In 2014, yet another American firm AECOM purchased URS corporation. Skype Technologies | Skype Technologies S.A.R.L (also known as Skype Software S.A.R.L, Skype Communications S.A.R.L, Skype Inc. and Skype Limited) is a telecommunications company headquartered in Luxembourg City, Luxembourg and Palo Alto, CA, United States, whose chief business is the manufacturing and marketing of the video chat and instant messaging computer software program Skype, and various Internet telephony services associated with it.
